notes.title: We're participating in "The Big Adventure Event"!
notes.content:
Hey guys! 

We're preparing John's Tombstone demo for January 20th! We'll be participating in The Big Adventure Event! So prepare for:

[list]
[*]Flashy new demo
[*]A broadcast with the developer!
[*]A mindbending game with a rich story
[/list]
